title: Cross‑SDK networking hygiene: timeouts, keepalive pooling, and streaming retry recipes
creator: Ava Chen
description: Background: SDK users across Python/TypeScript/Go report connection flakiness and confusing timeout behavior when using long-polling/streaming or high-QPS inference routes. Existing doc snippets are inconsistent between SDKs and don't cover streaming reconnect semantics or pool sizing heuristics. This ticket is to design and deliver a cross-SDK set of defaults, examples, and recipes for: 1) per-request deadlines and dual-deadline patterns (connect vs. total), 2) keepalive and connection-pool stewardship (idle pruning, max-conns per host), and 3) streaming ergonomics and retry/resume patterns with example code for Python/TS/Go. Goal: ship consistent defaults + cookbook examples and telemetry so customers have predictable behavior and platform can surface useful guidance.
acceptance_criteria: Consistent default transport config in all three SDKs (python/ts/go) configurable by users
Documentation page with cookbook: timeout patterns, pool sizing heuristics, keepalive tuning, streaming reconnect recipes
Three example snippets (Python/TS/Go) showing recommended configs and streaming reconnect + resume token usage
Unit and integration tests exercising: idle connection pruning, conn reuse, per-request deadlines, and streaming reconnect path
Telemetry emitted: sdk.socket_reuse_rate, sdk.idle_conn_closed_count, sdk.conn_pool_wait_ms_p50/p95, streaming.reconnect_count
Safety: retries applied only to idempotent operations or with explicit user opt-in for non-idempotent routes
Security review completed for changes in default connection behavior (keepalive and KMS/credentials interaction)
proposed_solution: Introduce 'dual_deadline' concept: connect_timeout + overall_timeout (total request deadline). SDKs expose as two configurable params; default: connect_timeout=3s, total_timeout=30s for typical generation, shorter for embeddings (connect=1s, total=10s).

Connection pool heuristics: default max_connections = max(2, min(100, ceil(qps * avg_latency_seconds * 1.5))). Provide explicit per-route override and global pool_size parameter. Idle connection pruning policy: idle_ttl=60s, background reaper frequency=30s. Document guidance for high-concurrency server-side usage vs low QPS clients.

Keepalive tuning: enable TCP keepalive with keepalive_interval=30s, keepalive_probes=3. Also expose 'http2_ping_interval' for gRPC/HTTP2 transports when supported to keep NAT mappings alive for streaming sessions.

Streaming ergonomics: introduce resume_token in streaming API. SDK will surface a small helper to buffer last ACKed event and on transient failure attempt automatic reconnect with exponential backoff (base=200ms, max=8s) and resume token. Only enable auto-resume for routes marked 'reconnectable' by server response metadata.

Retry recipe: classify errors into retryable (transient network, 5xx gateway) vs terminal (4xx client). For streaming, retries should re-establish stream and resume when server supports it; otherwise fall back to a clear error to the app. Provide opt-in 'unsafe_retries' flag for caller-managed idempotency keys.

Instrument telemetry around socket stewardship and add SDKs' debug logs to surface pool saturation and per-request deadlines being hit. Expose a debug flag to dump active socket table for local debugging.
Deliverables: SDK config API changes, three cookbook examples, docs page, e2e tests (local harness), and a small runtime policy change to annotate routes as reconnectable when resume is supported.
telemetry_and_tests: Add metrics: sdk.socket_reuse_rate (gauge), sdk.idle_conn_closed_count (counter), sdk.conn_pool_wait_ms_p50/p95 (histogram), streaming.reconnect_count (counter)
E2E test: start local proxy that simulates delayed connect, dropped sockets, and verify SDK reuses sockets and honors connect_timeout vs total_timeout
Unit tests: assert pool sizing calc given qps/latency, assert idle reaper removes connections after idle_ttl, assert dual_deadline precedence (per-request overrides global)
Integration: run Python/TS/Go sample against staging runtime with resume_token enabled and verify automatic resume occurs for transient network failures
